title: Interaction of Natural Compounds in Licorice and Turmeric with HIV-NCp7 Zinc Finger Domain: Potential Relevance to the Mechanism of Antiviral Activity.
authors: Wang, Runjing; Wei, Yinyu; Wang, Meiqin; Yan, Pan; Jiang, Hongliang; Du, Zhifeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物与HIV核衣壳蛋白锌指结构域（蛋白质-DNA互作相关）的结合，采用荧光、质谱、圆二色谱和分子对接方法，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-核酸互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Nucleocapsid proteins (NCp) are zinc finger (ZF) proteins, and they play a central role in HIV virus replication, mainly by interacting with nucleic acids. Therefore, they are potential targets for anti-HIV therapy. Natural products have been shown to be able to inhibit HIV, such as turmeric and licorice, which is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine. Liquiritin (LQ), isoliquiritin (ILQ), glycyrrhizic acid (GL), glycyrrhetinic acid (GA) and curcumin (CUR), which were the major active components, were herein chosen to study their interactions with HIV-NCp7 C-terminal zinc finger, aiming to find the potential active compounds and reveal the mechanism involved. The stacking interaction between NCp7 tryptophan and natural compounds was evaluated by fluorescence. To elucidate the binding mode, mass spectrometry was used to characterize the reaction mixture between zinc finger proteins and active compounds. Subsequently, circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy and molecular docking were used to validate and reveal the binding mode from a structural perspective. The results showed that ILQ has the strongest binding ability among the tested compounds, followed by curcumin, and the interaction between ILQ and the NCp7 zinc finger peptide was mediated by a noncovalent interaction. This study provided a scientific basis for the antiviral activity of turmeric and licorice.
abstract_zh: 核衣壳蛋白（NCp）是锌指（ZF）蛋白，在HIV病毒复制中发挥核心作用，主要通过与核酸相互作用实现。因此，它们是抗HIV治疗的潜在靶点。天然产物已被证明能够抑制HIV，例如姜黄和甘草，后者在传统中药中广泛使用。本研究选取甘草苷（LQ）、异甘草苷（ILQ）、甘草酸（GL）、甘草次酸（GA）和姜黄素（CUR）作为主要活性成分，研究它们与HIV-NCp7 C端锌指的相互作用，旨在发现潜在活性化合物并揭示其作用机制。通过荧光法评估了NCp7色氨酸与天然化合物之间的堆积相互作用。为阐明结合模式，采用质谱法表征锌指蛋白与活性化合物之间的反应混合物。随后，利用圆二色（CD）光谱和分子对接从结构角度验证并揭示结合模式。结果表明，在所测试的化合物中，ILQ具有最强的结合能力，其次是姜黄素，且ILQ与NCp7锌指肽之间的相互作用由非共价作用介导。本研究为姜黄和甘草的抗病毒活性提供了科学依据。
